about: Every public CS2 lineup on www.cs2util.com (smoke / flash pages of 7 maps, fetched 2026-11-03) that a getpos line alone repeats: standing or crouched still, or a standing jump-throw. Each row: map, kind, move, button, getpos line, CS2's recorded landing / pop point (worldCoordinates.effectPosition, Hammer units), the site's air time (s, or null), name, page id (https://www.cs2util.com/<map>/<kind>/<id>). Not Valve data: positions and angles players publish. Used by tests/gd-lineups.mjs (the whole-set pass rate).
